name: Make It Make Sense
install: python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade uv && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && { [ -d .venv ] || uv venv; } && uv pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && cd ../frontend && npm ci && cd .. && (command -v pre-commit >/dev/null || uv tool install pre-commit) && pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type pre-push
